newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: IHC Caland wins Dfl 175 mln of new orders.
newsitem.headline: IHC Caland wins Dfl 175 mln of new orders.

text.p: Shipbuilding and engineering group IHC Caland NV said on Monday it had received new orders worth around 175 million guilders.
Belgian dredging concern DEME has placed an order with IHC Holland for a 13,700 cubic metre trailing suction hopper dredger to be delivered in May 1999, IHC Caland said.
DEME has also signed a letter of intent for the construction of a 17,000 cubic metre "jumbo dredger".
In addition, South Coast Shipping will exercise an option to build a large sea-going dredger.
The two contracts, excluding the letter of intent, amount to around 175 million guilders.
